parameters.content:
## MySivi Ad Library, control finder

Sample mode scores the 11 Nov 2026 pull and spends nothing. That run is the PDF.

Live mode: paste an Apify token, set mode to apify, set asOf to today, leave maxAds at 12. No residential proxy. scrapeAdDetails is off.

Paste a Gemini key only if you want a translation and a clamped nudge. A quote that is not in the ad scores 0. The rank does not come from the model.

Best ad in the saved pull: library ID 1112422725088441, score 85.
